properties.name: Patel Road barrel (1976 plan), East Patel Nagar

properties.note: Alignment: the barrel runs along Patel Road for 2,000 m from the Pusa Road and Shankar Road crossing. Older source conflict: the 1976 plan lists it among MCD drains.

properties.name: Daryai Nallah barrel, Pusa Road crossing (inferred)
properties.citation: OpenStreetMap way/1378604253 (road line, ODbL, retrieved 2026-10-10); 1976 master plan lists Daryai Nallah among the MCD drains of Karol Bagh Zone; I&FC Master Plan for drainage of the MCD and DDA area (1976), Karol Bagh Zone
properties.note: Position: north end of Bazaar Marg where it meets Pusa Road, about 800 m of route from the Shankar Road origin in the 1976 text. Context asset, not linked to the pocket: a pocket's drainage is limited by its worst linked drain, so linking two would make cleaning either one worth nothing in the simulator.
